headline: Raj Oil Mills files financial results for period ended September 30, 2026
hook: September quarter financial results submitted to NSE
summary: Raj Oil Mills Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. This routine regulatory filing provides updated financial data regarding the company's performance during the quarter. Shareholders and retail investors can review these figures to assess the company's recent operational progress.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers offer transparency on Raj Oil Mills' financial health.

headline: Raj Oil Mills Ltd changes name to Raj Consumer Care Ltd
summary: The company formerly known as Raj Oil Mills Limited has officially changed its name to Raj Consumer Care Limited, effective 13 October 2026. The rebranding aims to align the corporate identity with a broader consumer‑care focus. Existing shareholders and market participants will see the new name reflected in NSE filings and stock quotes under the ROML ticker. Indian retail investors should note the change as it may affect sector classification and future analyst coverage.
why_it_matters: Stock may be re‑classified, affecting sector exposure
